newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Highlights of Tuesday's Commission briefing.
newsitem.headline: Highlights of Tuesday's Commission briefing.

text.p: Following are highlights of the midday briefing by the European Commission on Tuesday:

Spokesman Joao Vale de Almeida said Wednesday's Commission meeting agenda would include a method for calculating fines resulting from Court of Justice judgments (art 171 par. 2 of the EU Treaty) and an orientation debate on the inter-governmental conference.

Vale de Almeida said there would be an EU/Russia summit on 3 or 4 February in The Hague between Dutch Prime Minister Wim Kok, Commission President Jacques Santer and Russian President Boris Yeltsin. He said the summit would take place in the framework of the EU/Russia partnership and cooperation agreement.

In answer to a question, spokesman Willy Helin said the Commission had not yet received the new restructuring plan for France's Credit Lyonnais. Since the Commission should take a decision by March 31, 1997, it has become urgent to obtain this plan, he said.
The Commission released the following documents:
- IP/97/2: EU/Canada: progress towards an agreement on customs cooperation.
- IP/97/3: Single Market: trade barrier transparency procedure enters into effect.
- Speech/97/1: Speech by Commissioner Hans van den Broek at national horticulture companies award ceremony.
